d: Long, wavy champagne blonde hair with thick bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, light blue eyes and a slight smile. This slender adolescent build is dressed in an olive green crop top under an open brown aviator jacket with a white fleece collar, paired with short brown fleece-lined shorts, a dark brown belt featuring a large red star buckle, and black knee-high boots. Accessories include a brown aviator cap with goggles and earflaps, a grey tactical neck mask, brown fingerless gloves, a black thigh strap with a pouch, and a small black cylindrical canister hanging from a shoulder strap.
